info.title: FHK Backend API
info.description:
REST API backend for **FintechKids (FHK)** with JWT authentication, security middleware, automated audit logging, and multi-environment persistence (**Render** + **Neon Serverless PostgreSQL**).

### Active Environments
| Environment | Base URL | Git Branch | Neon DB Branch |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **Development** | `https://fintechkids-backend-dev.onrender.com` | `develop` | `development` |
| **Stage (QA)** | `https://fintechkids-backend-stage.onrender.com` | `develop` | `stage` |
| **Production** | `https://fintechkids-backend.onrender.com` | `main` | `production` |
| **Local** | `http://localhost:8000` | `develop` | `SQLite (fhk.db)` |

### Standardized Error Contract
All non-2xx responses return a unified JSON payload with a machine-readable `error_code` (`ErrorResponse`):
```json
{
  "error_code": "INVALID_RECOVERY_CODE",
  "detail": "The 6-digit recovery code is incorrect."
}
```

get.summary: Check whether the app has the latest store version installed
get.description:
Public **GET** endpoint. You **MUST** send both `platform` and `current_version` as **Query Parameters**:

| Query Parameter | Required | Allowed Values | Example |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `platform` | **Yes** | `IOS` or `AND` | `IOS` |
| `current_version` | **Yes** | Semantic version string (e.g. `1.0.0`) | `1.0.0` |

**Example Request:**
`GET /api/v1/app-version/check?platform=IOS&current_version=1.0.0`

Compares `current_version` against the latest published store version to indicate whether the app is up to date, if an optional update is available (`update_available: true`), or if a mandatory update is required (`force_update: true`).

get.summary: Get remote app configuration (languages, bottom-bar menus, and cache TTL)
get.description:
Public **GET** endpoint replacing Firebase Remote Config for the mobile client.

Returns:
- `cached_time_expiration`: Cache duration in minutes.
- `enabled_languages`: Map of language codes to booleans (`{"es": true, "fr": true, ...}`) so individual languages can be toggled off without removing them.
- `menus_bottom_bar_enables`: List of bottom-bar menu item configurations (`id`, `name`, `icon`, `label_localized_key`, `active`).

put.description: Updates `cached_time_expiration`, `enabled_languages`, and/or `menus_bottom_bar_enables` in the database for the current environment. Any omitted (`null`) field keeps its existing value.

tags.name: 1. Server Status
tags.description: Service health check and availability status.

tags.name: 2. App Version (Stores)
tags.description: Check the currently installed app version (`IOS` or `AND`) against the latest version published in stores.

tags.name: 3. Authentication
tags.description: Family registration, login, 6-digit password recovery, and JWT token refresh (`access_token` and `refresh_token`).

tags.name: 4. Users / Family
tags.description: Retrieve and update the authenticated parent / family profile.

tags.name: 5. Family Members
tags.description: Create, update, list, and delete family members linked to the parent account.

tags.name: 6. Family Tasks
tags.description: Create, edit, list (all or `enable` only), and delete family tasks created by the parent.

tags.name: 7. Parent Goals
tags.description: Create and manage base goals configured by the family parent/guardian.

tags.name: 8. Parent Rewards
tags.description: Create and manage rewards configured by the family parent/guardian.

tags.name: 9. Member Goals
tags.description: Assign, list, update progress (`accumulated_value`), and delete goals selected by family members.

tags.name: 10. Member Rewards
tags.description: Claim rewards (`PENDING`), update delivery state (`COLLECTED`), and delete claimed member rewards.

tags.name: 11. Member Balances
tags.description: Create, retrieve, and update the coin (`coins_obtained`) and time (`time_obtained`) balance of each family member.

tags.name: 12. Activity History (Audit Logs)
tags.description: Query the automated historical activity and audit trail recorded per family.

tags.name: 13. Remote Config
tags.description: Retrieve and update global remote app configuration (cache TTL, enabled languages, and bottom-bar menu flags).
